usage_rule: Only anchors with kind in {analytic, experiment} may gate a verdict. 'code_to_code' entries are cross-checks, never gates. Values transcribed from the cited sources are marked transcribed=true; re-read the published version before promoting a case to verified/.

analytic.source: Wagner (1932) ZAMM 12:193-215; as stated in De Rosis & Tafuni (2022) Eq.(45)

formula.force: F_W(t) = rho_l * pi^2 * V^2 * a_W(t) / (4 * tan(zeta)),  a_W(t) = c(t)

repo_crosscheck.note: src/tensorlbm/wagner_theory.py wagner_wedge_total_force returns 1.2732x (4/pi) the integral of its own wagner_wedge_pressure leading term and 1.2732x the analytic force above. wagner_wedge_slamming_coefficient returns pi/tan(beta), which contradicts its own docstring C_s = pi^2/(2 tan^2 beta). Do NOT use these two functions as gates until fixed (blocker B6).

analytic.formula: C_F = F / (rho V^2 pi R^2) = pi * sqrt(h / (2R))

repo_crosscheck.note: wagner_sphere_force and wagner_sphere_force_coefficient are mutually consistent: F = rho V^2 (pi^2/2) a R with a = sqrt(2Rh) yields exactly pi*sqrt(h/2R) after non-dimensionalisation (checked 2026-10-30).

experiment.source: Colicchio, Greco, Miozzi & Lugni (2009), 24th Int. Workshop on Water Waves and Floating Bodies; values as tabulated in De Rosis & Tafuni (2022) Table 1
experiment.transcription_note: Table 1 of the accepted manuscript; only the two headline peaks are unambiguous. The time-series tables in that manuscript's Fig.4 are column-ambiguous after text extraction and MUST be re-read from the published version before use.

experiment.source: Fekken (2004) PhD thesis; Campbell & Vignjevic (2012); values as tabulated in De Rosis & Tafuni (2022) Table 2
Fekken (2004) VOF study; De Rosis & Tafuni (2022) Section 3.1
